red_results.name: red-crypto
red_results.meaning: Exit 0 means the dedicated reproducer successfully observed the OLD BUG. With crypto capability clear, crypto-marked read/write requests returned success and transferred plaintext; it is not a passing correctness gate and not a fixed binary.

counts.note: Check groups, completed source/receiver transfers, rejected loads and source-only profile captures are different units. No full-suite gate count is inferred.

interpretation.crypto_green_media_scope: The encrypted-write-preserves-entire-media check passed, and the encrypted-read buffer remained unchanged with OCS=9. Overall before/after media hashes differ because this suite also performs ordinary I/O and recovery I/O; do not report whole-suite media immutability.
capability_boundaries: ICE registers provide explicit unsupported/read-only probe behavior; no encryption/keyslot/TEE execution is implemented.
Auto-Hibern8 is a digital driver-state and virtual-deadline model, without silicon/analog timing equivalence.
UFS process checkpoints require quiescent legacy storage queues and externally reused media; no in-flight SCSI or copied media claim.
PDC/RPMh receipt covers held sleep/wake transitions, actual GIC pending state, W1C and process restoration; it does not establish whole-board or Android suspend/resume.
The PCI 17-case regression includes legacy and MCQ crypto-rejection coverage; it is a separate generic PCI binary.
This collection contains no tablet access, native media, raw disks or migration blobs, and no final TBU-integrated acceptance.
